out.subject: 1.4404 bar – volume-based contract proposal
out.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and the explanation of the cost movements. I appreciate the stock availability you offer. For a regular annual volume, however, I would like you to quote a dedicated volume tier rather than apply the general offer unchanged.

Our proposal is EUR 4.84 per kg for a 24-month contract, with 94800 kg per year throughout the contract and payment at 90 days net. The package includes an AS-14404 index clause with a 5% deadband, a 45% material share and August 2026 as the base month. This gives us a defined mechanism for alloy movements alongside a volume-based starting price.

I have attached our latest monthly forecast to make the demand profile transparent; see the figures below. Please review the proposed package and confirm the volume-tier price you can offer on this basis.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Open with the deepest available level on the requested indexed package, retain the payment terms, and support the annual volume with the shared forecast.

out.subject: Volume commitment and revised price for stainless bar
out.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for recognising the forecast and incorporating the 24-month term and AS-14404 clause. To answer your volume question directly: we can commit to 94800 kg per year throughout the contract. The monthly forecast is attached again for your review.

Your comments on payment differ from the quoted package, which states 90 days net. We are retaining 90 days net in our proposal; the shorter-payment option is not the basis of this discussion.

I can revise our proposed price to EUR 4.95 per kg, keeping the 24-month contract and AS-14404 clause with a 5% deadband, a 45% material share and August 2026 as the base month unchanged.

Our purchase-order history provides a concrete reference for this business; see the figures below. The binding annual volume and the fixed-price alloy cover described in your letter support a sharper starting price alongside the agreed index mechanism.

Please review EUR 4.95 per kg on this package and confirm that your quotation retains payment at 90 days net.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Uses the smallest available upward price move on the unchanged package, answers the volume question explicitly, addresses the inconsistent payment wording, and supports the revised proposal with purchase-order evidence.

out.subject: Volume commitment and revised price proposal
out.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for recognising our firm volume commitment and retaining payment at 90 days net in your revised offer. I appreciate the movement on price and your verification of the purchase-order history.

To answer your volume question: our binding commitment remains 94800 kg per year throughout the 24-month contract. We are not proposing a higher annual quantity. I have attached the monthly forecast again so you can assess the demand profile on that basis.

I can revise our proposal to EUR 4.96 per kg. Payment remains at 90 days net, with the 24-month term and AS-14404 index clause unchanged: a 5% deadband, a 45% material share and August 2026 as the base month.

You have identified PPI-C2431 as a main price driver. Please consider the recent figures below alongside the annual movements cited in your original offer when reviewing the starting price.

Please review this revised price on the stated volume and unchanged terms and let me know what further movement you can make.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Makes the smallest available upward price move on the unchanged package, answers the repeated volume question precisely, acknowledges the retained payment terms, and introduces recent evidence for a cost driver the supplier cited.
